brief: Slovenian bank corporate channels are a rich, mostly open, Slovenian-first source layer for leadership and org-change intelligence: NLB and SID banka run dated, well-structured investor/news feeds, Delavska hranilnica maintains an explicit 'Obvestila' announcements index, and Gorenjska banka, Addiko SI, Intesa Sanpaolo SI and Hranilnica LON each publish appointment notices on their own sites. Two structural anchors sit above the individual banks: SEOnet (statutory regulated-information repository) for listed issuers, and the Bank of Slovenia register of supervised entities as the canonical actor map — with SDH acting as an upstream announcer of supervisory-board nominations at state-owned banks. Consolidation has reshaped the cell: Nova KBM and SKB are now a single OTP banka entity and Sberbank's successor was absorbed into NLB, so legacy newsroom assumptions must be revalidated. The main uncovered ground is the hiring side (no career/vacancy portals enumerated yet), the smallest savings banks with no press function, and the statutory registers that would give legally-dated confirmation of each appointment.
